o.text: From Proto-Turkic *burun. Compare Old Turkic [script needed] (burın, burun).
From Proto-Common Turkic *kalpak. See more at English calpack and Turkish kalpak.
From yaradıcı + -lıq. Senses likely influenced by Russian тво́рчество (tvórčestvo).
Morphologically abadlaş- + -dır, from abad. Senses align with Russian благоустро́ить (blagoustróitʹ), suggesting semantic influence.
